<h1 className={"openapi__heading"}>List the API tokens of an account.</h1>

<MethodEndpoint method={"get"} path={"/v1/api-tokens"}></MethodEndpoint>



Returns all the API tokens of the account that owns the API token in the request.

Must be run with an API token that has the **Admin** role. API tokens created before token roles were introduced have the same permissions as Admin.

Please ensure to change the region in the URL to match your account's region.
